items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: So I had a friend of mine...another friend called Wallace Sellers (?). He was travellin' with me, too.

ctx.x: So I had a friend of mine...another friend called Wallace Sellers (?). He was travellin' with me, too. I had three chauffeurs. I had Herman the German, Wallace Sellers, another...another boy called Bute (?). They were just like to travel and havin' fun an' so they travel around with me all up and down the highway. All I do's get back in the back seat an' go to sleep an' they would take me anywhere I was s'posed to go. So we went an' played one-nighters all up and down the ...the highway.

So then I took off and went to Australia. I left Wallace and the band up in Oakland, California. S'posed to go to Australia. I went to Australia, an' we stayed over there a month with Bill Haley and his band. 'Course I didn't sing with Bill Haley. I sang with the other band that was with us on the tour. We had The Platters, The Drifters, and a host of other players...all sorts of blues singers.
